item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\np={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':2,'s':'x'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}\\ncases=[\\n({'layers':[{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''},'error':None}),\\n({'layers':[{'i':'bad'},{'i':4}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':4,'s':'x'},'error':None}),\\n({'layers':[{'i':None}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':2,'s':'x'},'error':None}),\\n({'environment':{'b':'false','i':'-12','s':''}},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':-12,'s':''},'error':None}),\\n({'environment':{'i':'+1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),\\n({'environment':{'i':' 1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),\\n({'environment':{'b':'False'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),\\n({'layers':[{'i':True}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),\\n({'layers':[{'z':1}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'})]\\nfor n,(req,exp) in enumerate(cases):\\n got=evaluate(req,p)\\n assert got==exp,(n,got,exp)\\np0={**p,'null_resets':False,'environment':False}\\nassert evaluate({'layers':[{'i':None}]},p0)=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}\\nassert evaluate({'environment':{'i':'2'}},p0)=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}\\npolicy=json.load(open('policy.json'))\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json'))\\nreport=json.load(open('report.json'))\\nassert report==[evaluate(req,policy) for req in requests]\\nschema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))\\nfor result in report: assert set(result)==set(schema['required'])\\nprint('ok',len(cases)+2,'boundary cases and report')\"]}"}
